outcome: The final die result is the natural result plus or minus all applicable modifiers, and that final result decides the effect.

note: optional modifiers and mana activation are player choices
the roller chooses the order of competing modifiers

outcome: After a roll, the effect listed for the range containing the result happens, and no effect happens if no range contains it.
A Roll again instruction rolls the same kind and number of dice with the same modifiers and the new result selects the effect.
Celebr-8000's extra effect happens only when both dice show equal results.
An ignored roll counts as never having happened: no roll-triggered ability fires and no effect applies to it.

note: Planechase planar die; Planechase is a casual variant not played in two-player collection

outcome: Rolling dice with a storing ability records the die kind and value as stored results on the permanent.
Rerolling stored results rolls one die of each noted kind, removes the old stored results and stores the new ones.

note: linking of abilities; covered by 706.8a and 706.8b
